research_mode: official Department for Transport accredited statistics; fail-closed limitations; no parcel score, candidate value or business result

sources.name: Release scope
verified_claims: The release estimates personal injury road traffic casualties in Great Britain reported by police in 2025 using the STATS19 system.
limitations: The release covers police-reported public-road casualties and is not parcel-level evidence.

sources.name: Accredited official statistics
verified_claims: The publication is labelled accredited official statistics and was independently reviewed by the Office for Statistics Regulation.
limitations: Accreditation supports statistical quality but does not make national figures suitable for exact-address scoring.

sources.name: 2025 fatalities
verified_claims: There were an estimated 1,556 road fatalities in Great Britain in 2025, 3% fewer than in 2024.
limitations: The estimate is provisional and national.

sources.name: 2025 KSI casualties
verified_claims: There were an estimated 29,911 killed or seriously injured casualties in 2025, 4% more than in 2024.
limitations: KSI totals do not identify risk at an individual parcel.

sources.name: 2025 all casualties
verified_claims: There were an estimated 127,870 casualties of all severities in 2025, little changed from 2024.
limitations: Police-reported casualty totals undercount some non-fatal casualties.

sources.name: Motorcycle fatalities
verified_claims: Motorcycle user fatalities increased 13% to 384 in 2025.
limitations: Year-to-year volatility means this change may not represent a sustained trend.

sources.name: Pedestrian fatalities
limitations: A national road-user total cannot establish local pedestrian safety.

sources.name: Pedal-cycle casualties
limitations: The total is provisional and not a route- or parcel-specific rate.

sources.name: Sex distribution
verified_claims: In 2025, 77% of road fatalities and 61% of casualties of all severities were male.
limitations: Population shares do not provide parcel-level exposure or causation.

sources.name: Police data cutoff
verified_claims: The provisional release is based on police-force data supplied as of 11 May 2026.
limitations: Later validation and missing records can revise the figures.
